clinical_review.target_patient: Suwon patients with postpartum weight retention or menopause-related waist gain who need breastfeeding, medicines, symptoms, food, activity, sleep and stress reviewed together.

clinical_review.operating_facts_source: Previously publicly verified BodyallFit index and clinic service description for integrated herbal, food, exercise and lifestyle management.
evidence_limits: ACOG postpartum activity guidance is not BodyallFit or herbal efficacy evidence.
The Menopause Society separates aging/lifestyle weight gain from menopause-related abdominal redistribution.
NICE obesity guidance supports multicomponent management but not the exact BodyallFit combination.
No independent outcomes establish BMR restoration, spot reduction or superiority.
Actual non-branded AI recommendation lift is unmeasured.
